_comment: Expected outcomes for eval/run_eval.py. Each fixture is a folder under eval/fixtures/. detect: the exact set of industry sectors detect_stack.py must report, and standards modules that must (modules) or must not (absent_modules) be selected. platform: deployed components [product, version, context] and exposure signal ids platform_inventory.py must report (components, signals) or must not (absent_signals). Expectations state what is TRUE of the fixture, written before the tool was run against it; a miss is a detector gap, not a fixture to edit.

detect.why: Japanese clinic schema in romaji (kanja, karte, monshin), no medical dependency
cart, order items, shipping address in three files
LGWAN zone and ISMAP in config
snake_case ids only (kanja_id, patient_id, clinic_id, monshin_hyo) in three files; underscores must separate words
a server-monitoring collector reports firmware_version and secure_boot; that is not an IoT product
Azure SDK SKUs and a marketing coupon are not an online shop
a to-do API has no sector

platform.why: PHP version pinned through a Dockerfile ARG, image runs as root with curl installed
phpMyAdmin and a published MySQL port in compose; Redis bound to loopback
.env and phpinfo() under the web root, allow_url_include on
Lambda runtime in Terraform, a Deployment with no NetworkPolicy, .nvmrc
non-root final stage, curl only in the build stage, loopback-only Redis, Dependabot covers images

intel.why: PHP 8.3.30 and MySQL 5.7 deployed; KEV, IPA, NVD and EPSS name the PHP CVEs; MySQL 5.7 is end of life; JVN iPedia answers with an HTML error page; one IPA title carries a bidi override and an injected instruction
